Container.Name: unraid-mobile
Container.Overview: Unraid Mobile read-only system, storage, Docker and VM preview. Mount /proc, /sys and /var/local/emhttp read-only for host metrics and storage. Optionally mount /var/run/docker.sock for container states and resource statistics. Optionally mount /var/run/libvirt for VM states and assigned resources through libvirt-sock-ro. VM preview is disabled by default; VM_READ_ENABLED=true is only for target-host validation. Missing data is shown explicitly. Docker/VM/Array/Parity operations are not enabled. No privileged access is required. A read-only socket mount does not restrict Engine API permissions; the application issues only read requests.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Open the web interface on this host port.

Config.Name: Host procfs
Config.Description: Read-only host process and metrics filesystem.

Config.Name: Unraid storage state
Config.Description: Read-only storage metadata. Required for Array, Parity, Pools and disk capacity/temperature.

Config.Name: Docker Engine socket
Config.Description: Optional container states and statistics. Read-only bind mode does not restrict socket API permissions; the application only sends read requests.

Config.Name: Libvirt directory
Config.Description: Optional VM preview; requires libvirt-sock-ro. Only fixed read calls are sent. Target-host validation is still required. Directory mount survives socket recreation.

Config.Name: VM read preview
Config.Description: Unverified VM preview. Set true only for target-host read validation with libvirt-sock-ro mounted. Does not enable VM operations.

Config.Name: API token
Config.Description: Optional Bearer credential for all API requests. Empty keeps LAN mode. Does not enable writes or TLS; use encrypted remote access.

Config.Name: Server name
Config.Description: Display name for this Unraid server.
